app.name: Metroid
app.short_description: Explore Zebes and defeat the Metroids.
app.long_description: Samus Aran explores the hostile planet Zebes to destroy the Metroid threat. Wii Remote held sideways: D-Pad moves, 1 fires, 2 jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Classic Controller or Pro: D-Pad moves, B or Y fires, A jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Place metroid.nes in the SD card root.
